entries.text: Do you want to leave this team?
entries.label: oniballoon_matching_msg_01_00

entries.text: Do you want to disband the team?
entries.label: oniballoon_matching_msg_02_00

entries.text: One or more members of your team are not\nready yet. Please wait a bit before departing.
entries.label: oniballoon_matching_msg_03_00

entries.text: Welcome! You here for some Ogre Oustin’?
entries.label: oniballoon_entrynpc_01

entries.text: Let’s get you on out there so you can start oustin’\nsome ogres!
entries.label: oniballoon_entrynpc_02

entries.text: Come on back any time, ya hear?
entries.label: oniballoon_entrynpc_03

entries.text: Congrats on gettin’ through all the easy stages!\nTake these to commemorate your first time\r\nclearin’ that difficulty level!
entries.label: oniballoon_entrynpc_04

entries.text: You did a mighty fine job out there. I bet you’ll\nbe able to handle the normal stages now!
entries.label: oniballoon_entrynpc_05

entries.text: Congrats on gettin’ through all the normal stages!\nTake these to commemorate your first time\r\nclearin’ that difficulty level!
entries.label: oniballoon_entrynpc_06

entries.text: You did a mighty fine job out there. I bet you’ll\nbe able to handle the hard stages now!
entries.label: oniballoon_entrynpc_07

entries.text: Congrats on getting through all the hard stages!\nDefinitely doesn’t happen every day!
entries.label: oniballoon_entrynpc_08

entries.text: I reckon you might be the right Trainer to handle\nthat Pokémon...
entries.label: oniballoon_entrynpc_08_2

entries.text: Every time we started Ogre Oustin’, it’d draw\nin a Munchlax from ’round here...and boy, it\r\nhad quite an appetite!
entries.label: oniballoon_entrynpc_08_3

entries.text: Matter o’ fact, the game would get a whole\nlot harder while it was around...
entries.label: oniballoon_entrynpc_08_4

entries.text: So yeah, I was thinkin’ you should take it\nwith you!
entries.label: oniballoon_entrynpc_08_5

entries.text: You got a Munchlax from the lady!
entries.label: oniballoon_entrynpc_08_6

entries.text: Uh-oh! Your Boxes are full, huh? Why don’t you\ncome on back after doing a little housekeepin’?
entries.label: oniballoon_entrynpc_09

entries.text: Oh yeah, the Munchlax! Here ya go—for real,\nthis time!
entries.label: oniballoon_entrynpc_12
